title: CLUTCH PEDAL, CONTROL LINKAGE & PEDAL DIMENSION
summary: Clutch pedal and pushrod under the dash. The clutch pedal asm [2] pivots on its shaft in two bushings [1] in the brake pedal housing, retained by clip [6] on the shaft end; pedal pad cover [8] goes over plate [7] (bend tab at assembly) and bumper [9] is the pedal stop. Clutch pushrod [4] is pinned to the pedal arm with washers [3], [5] and clip [6], passes through the dash panel in seal [10], and connects via swivel [13], adjusting nuts [12] and retainer [14] to the clutch lever & shaft asm (cross shaft upper arm), with return spring [11]. Includes the clutch linkage adjustment (swivel gap .400 +/- .03), free pedal travel 1-1/2 +/- 1/4 and pedal height 7.00 +/- 0.25.

materials.where: tags in the drawing are faint/unreadable: at the pedal shaft bushings [1], on the pedal shaft [2], at the pushrod [4] pin on the pedal arm, and a blank tag at swivel [13]

fastening.note: Pedal [2] shaft runs through two bushings [1] in the brake pedal housing; clip [6] on the far end of the shaft retains it. CAUTION: the retainer must scribe a legible line on the shaft end during assembly; don't use an expanding tool that defeats this.
Pushrod [4] has its own bent pin end; it goes through the pedal arm hole with washer [3] on one side, washer [5] on the other, and clip [6] locks it. No separate pin.

fastening.to: dash panel, where pushrod [4] passes through
fastening.note: Seal [10] boots the pushrod at the dash panel opening.

fastening.to: steering anchor plate asm / dash panel beside seal [10]
fastening.note: Screw [15] is shown at the steering anchor plate next to the pushrod seal; what it clamps is not clear in the drawing.

fastening.to: upper arm of the clutch lever & shaft asm (cross shaft, sheet C1)
fastening.note: Swivel [13] pin goes through the clutch lever arm and is held by retainer [14]; the pushrod's threaded end passes through the swivel between two nuts [12] (nuts A and B in the adjustment view).

fastening.to: clutch lever arm (lower hole) and the steering anchor plate area under the dash
fastening.note: Return spring [11] hooks into a hole in the clutch lever arm at its lower end.
Plate [7] fits on the pedal end and the rubber cover [8] goes over it; BEND TAB SECURELY AT ASSEMBLY.
Bumper [9] pushes into a hole in the pedal housing as the pedal up-stop.

notes: CAUTION: Retainer must scribe a legible line on end of shaft during assembly. Do not use an expanding tool that would defeat this.
Adjustment: with nuts (A) and (B) loose on rod (D), push the lever with 5 lbs in direction of arrow (E) to take up the clearance between throwout bearing and clutch fingers.
Run nut (B) toward swivel (C) until dimension (X) is .400 +/- .03, then tighten nut (A) to lock the swivel against nut (B).
